Brian (PM): Quick sync — after the Q2 infra delay we need to re-evaluate what stays in SearchPilot MVP vs pushes to v1. I want a single agreed cut list by EOD Friday.
Lin (Eng Lead): Ack. Can we start with explicit non-negotiables? perf SLOs, auth, and single-tenant data isolation?
Zoe (Design): from UX side, the search result baseline (pagination + basic snippets) is required for usability. Advanced highlights can be v1.
Maya (Product Ops): Also flagging two enterprise prospects that need SSO; they'd accept a v1 timeline but it's a potential revenue drag if we delay too long.
Ajay (SRE): Practically, we need KV cache warming and circuit-breaker behavior by MVP to keep latency under control on 99p. Anything that requires cross-region replication can wait.
Jamie (DevEx): Dev experience: we'll ship a minimal SDK + examples in MVP. Full telemetry docs and rollout guides can be v1.
Lin (Eng Lead): Proposed MVP bucket (must ship): 1) Inference route with <200ms median latency for 512 tokens, 2) Auth + per-tenant isolation, 3) Basic observability (token-level cost + latency metrics), 4) Canary rollout + automatic fallback.
Brian (PM): Good. Proposed v1 features to de-prioritize: 1) multi-model auto-mesh, 2) advanced relevance tuning UI, 3) per-token custom billing, 4) on-prem packaging. Agree?
Zoe (Design): Agree on deprioritize list. Would like to keep one small UX polish for snippet density so results don't feel sparse. Can fit in MVP if Lin says it's cheap.
Lin (Eng Lead): Small snippet tweak is fine — but it must be toggleable. Anything that adds extra model calls (rerank/recall) moves to v1.
Maya (Product Ops): Timeline reset ask: if we cut the v1 items above, can we keep the public beta target of May 15?
Lin (Eng Lead): Realistic dev + QA + SRE burn suggests May 29 for public beta given current capacity. That's with the cuts.
Brian (PM): May 29 is OK if we communicate the shift — we need a short note for customers outlining what changed and why. Maya, can you draft?
Maya (Product Ops): On it. I'll include impact to prospects and next steps.
Ajay (SRE): We'll need an extended canary period — plan: 2 weeks of ramp at 10%/30%/70%. If any perf regression, automatic fallback to v0 variant.
Jamie (DevEx): I can add a short code snippet for the canary toggle: ```curl -X POST /rollouts -d '{"percent":10,"variant":"canary"}'``` and a brief troubleshooting checklist.
Brian (PM): Action items: Lin to post final cut list in /docs and update milestone board; Zoe to flag any UX must-haves that sneak back in; Maya to draft customer note; Ajay to confirm canary schedule; Jamie to update quickstart. Owners due by EOD Friday.
Lin (Eng Lead): I'll post the list with technical rationale. Expect a few trade-offs where we may reclassify features as "safe to ship" depending on effort.
Zoe (Design): Will tag anything that requires copy changes — call it out early.
deploy-bot: Deployment window scheduled for 2027-05-21 02:00 UTC (tentative)
Brian (PM): Thanks all. If anyone objects to the May 29 public beta after reading the cut list, raise it here before EOD. :thumbsup:
Maya (Product Ops): Noted. I'll coordinate the customer message and share a draft in this thread. :eyes:
